skills.title: Token DD Score · Advanced
skills.description: Explain token due-diligence risk through security, holders, activity, liquidity and smart-money evidence.

usage.instructions: Install birdeye-cli and configure your Birdeye API key. Replace placeholders with your inputs, preview the cost, then run with your chosen budget using --max-cu.
usage.result: Five scored pillars, coverage, drawdown gate and an auditable risk rating. Standard uses two calls; advanced uses seven. Saved evidence can be re-scored locally at zero CU.

skills.title: Trending List
skills.description: Discover tokens by activity, liquidity or market size, optionally within a launch platform.

usage.input: No address is required. Choose filters appropriate to the research question.
usage.instructions: Install birdeye-cli and configure your Birdeye API key. Replace placeholders with your inputs, preview the cost, then run with your chosen budget using --max-cu.
usage.result: A ranked token page. Choose V3 token list or native trending; sorting options follow the selected API.

skills.title: Smart Wallets
skills.description: Discover wallets trading tokens in Birdeye's smart-money list, then inspect a bounded wallet shortlist.

usage.input: No address is required. Choose filters appropriate to the research question.
usage.instructions: Install birdeye-cli and configure your Birdeye API key. Replace placeholders with your inputs, preview the cost, then run with your chosen budget using --max-cu.
usage.result: Token → top traders → deduplicated wallets. Standard adds PnL; deep adds holdings and per-token PnL. No overlapping token-level PnL is summed.

skills.title: Token DD
skills.description: Check market activity, security and smart-money context before taking a token further in research.

usage.instructions: Install birdeye-cli and configure your Birdeye API key. Replace placeholders with your inputs, preview the cost, then run with your chosen budget using --max-cu.
usage.result: Security observations, activity and labeled money flow. Optional holder list, holder groups and historical liquidity add evidence. No automatic buy recommendation.

skills.title: Contract DD
skills.description: Review contract controls, ownership concentration and price behavior together.

usage.instructions: Install birdeye-cli and configure your Birdeye API key. Replace placeholders with your inputs, preview the cost, then run with your chosen budget using --max-cu.
usage.result: Security checklist, holder distribution and optional candlestick analysis. Unknown controls stay unknown; price action cannot establish contract safety.

skills.title: RugCheck Audit
skills.description: Review contract, holder and actual liquidity-history evidence for potential risk.

usage.instructions: Install birdeye-cli and configure your Birdeye API key. Replace placeholders with your inputs, preview the cost, then run with your chosen budget using --max-cu.
usage.result: Birdeye observations, holder groups and historical liquidity snapshots. This is not a RugCheck.org integration; unavailable honeypot/LP-lock checks are explicit.

skills.title: Kline Pattern
skills.description: Classify observed candle behavior using the reference skill's trend, slope, volatility, drawdown, volume and recovery rules.

usage.instructions: Install birdeye-cli and configure your Birdeye API key. Replace placeholders with your inputs, preview the cost, then run with your chosen budget using --max-cu.
usage.result: Pattern, heuristic score and supporting measurements from closed candles. Thin or invalid data produces an unavailable result.

skills.title: Wallet Score
skills.description: Assess a wallet's profitability, consistency, position quality and activity from matching PnL windows.

usage.instructions: Install birdeye-cli and configure your Birdeye API key. Replace placeholders with your inputs, preview the cost, then run with your chosen budget using --max-cu.
usage.result: A versioned alpha heuristic with component breakdown and missing-data checks. Scores use fetched positions and are not a copy-trading return forecast.

skills.title: Wallet Style
skills.description: Describe how often a wallet trades and how profitable those trades were over a fixed period.

usage.instructions: Install birdeye-cli and configure your Birdeye API key. Replace placeholders with your inputs, preview the cost, then run with your chosen budget using --max-cu.
usage.result: Frequency × PnL classification with sample size and per-token loss share. Transaction and first-funding evidence are optional.

skills.title: Wallet Analysis
skills.description: Compare wallet PnL across several periods and inspect holdings, positions and recent activity.

usage.instructions: Install birdeye-cli and configure your Birdeye API key. Replace placeholders with your inputs, preview the cost, then run with your chosen budget using --max-cu.
usage.result: Selected PnL windows, per-token PnL, optional holdings, transactions and first funding. Overlapping periods are not added together.

skills.title: Smart Money Profile
skills.description: Combine short and monthly performance with position, trade and net-worth history for one wallet.

usage.instructions: Install birdeye-cli and configure your Birdeye API key. Replace placeholders with your inputs, preview the cost, then run with your chosen budget using --max-cu.
usage.result: 7d/30d PnL, position details, holdings, swaps and net-worth snapshots. Balance changes include cash flows and are not trading ROI.

skills.title: Smart Money Leaderboard
skills.description: Compare an explicit list of wallets using consistent PnL windows and accounting.

usage.input: One to ten Solana wallet addresses, separated by commas.
usage.instructions: Install birdeye-cli and configure your Birdeye API key. Replace placeholders with your inputs, preview the cost, then run with your chosen budget using --max-cu.
usage.result: 7d/30d performance and per-token evidence per wallet, ranked with higher PnL scoring higher. Missing metrics remain unranked.
